new_findings.text: The behead damage multiplier is a v0.682->v0.717 TUNING DIVERGENCE: android NPC.as multiplies a behead hit by 1.5, the web NPC class multiplies it by 1.3. Both sit in the same method of the same class, after the same defense subtraction and the same getMinDamage floor, so this is a straight retune and not a structural difference. A v0.717-targeted recreation must port 1.3.

new_findings.text: The free weapon-part parry is a BASE-CLASS rule, not an EnemyZombie quirk: NPC.as carries the identical `case mcs.partList[MCSCharacter.PART_weapon]: gotHitFlag = false; damage = 0; return false;` in its own hit switch, and the web NPC class confirms it in v0.717. Every NPC in the game nullifies a blade-path hit that intersects its rendered weapon, and the hit is aborted before the HP path rather than merely reduced.

new_findings.lane_impact: L-combat-core: packet claims 12 and 13 both read the EnemyZombie override correctly but scope the mechanic to the undead. It is universal and build-stable, which promotes it from an undead flavour note to a first-order blade-path rule: the per-part damage verdict needs a NULLIFY outcome for every enemy, and the rendered sword is a parry surface on the whole roster.
